questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “Practical lesson. Interaction of acids with metals" from similar ideas?
questionUz: “Amaliy dars. Kislotalarning metallar bilan o‘zaro ta’siri”ni o‘xshash g‘oyalardan qaysi formula aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: As a result, zinc displaced hydrogen atoms from hydrochloric acid molecules, and molecules were formed from the atoms.
A complex substance that forms H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ions in an aqueous solution
choicesUz: Natijada, rux xlorid kislota molekulalaridan vodorod atomlarini siqib chiqardi va atomlardan molekulalar hosil bo'ldi.
Suvli eritmada H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ionlarini hosil qiluvchi murakkab modda.
explanationEn: As a result, zinc displaced hydrogen atoms from hydrochloric acid molecules, hydrogen molecules were formed from the atoms, and experiment confirmed this.
explanationUz: Natijada rux xlorid kislota molekulalaridan vodorod atomlarini siqib chiqardi, atomlardan vodorod molekulalari hosil bo'ldi va tajriba buni tasdiqladi.
